findings.summary: The modeled current-source check accepts extra observed paths absent from the independently approved inventory, despite the claim of complete equality.

counterexample.observation: path 7 -> digest 1; path 8 -> digest 2; all other paths -> none

findings.reason: Observation is a total function, while checks traverses only ApprovedSurface.entries. It has no enumerable current inventory and never rejects an unlisted observed path.
